exact_claim_text: In the synthetic worked dataset for the declared exercise, the checklist condition is associated with fewer unresolved errors, while completion-time uncertainty includes practically small differences.
method_or_source: Predeclared checklist and standard-instruction conditions, with baseline adjustment, missingness record and uncertainty intervals.
uncertainty: Synthetic data, limited sample, task specificity, non-blinded condition and sensitivity to missingness assumptions.
boundary: Illustrative synthetic sample in one exercise; no population prevalence, causal generalisation beyond the design or long-term learning claim.
counter_evidence_or_alternative: Completion-time differences are unstable across plausible missingness treatments and confidence increases more than observed performance.
stronger_wording_rejected: The checklist improves debugging ability for informatics students generally.
